posts.text:
Meta releases Muse Spark Open, an 816B model it calls America's best open one
https://theaipost.net/story/muse-spark-open-weights/

OpenAI ships GPT-Live-1.1 voice with six new languages

OpenAI says GPT-Live-1.1 is rolling out today to all users in ChatGPT, Codex and dots, with new voices in six languages and fewer "checking..." pauses.

https://theaipost.net/story/cc63326e9/

Microsoft finishes MAI-Base-2, a 3-trillion-parameter base model built in-house

Microsoft AI says its MAI-Base-2 base model beats every open-weight model it tested and is 4 to 12 times more pre-training efficient than DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Base.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-microsoft-mai-base-2/

Xiaomi's MiMo V2.6 Pro takes top open spot in Arena's Agent leaderboard

Arena says MiMo V2.6 Pro leads open models in Agent Arena at $0.11 per task, and is one of only two open models on the cost frontier.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-agent-arena-mimo-v26-pro/

Liquid AI releases d1-ultra, a model it says tops a decision index

Liquid AI says d1-ultra, a multimodal model covering 44 languages, scores 65 and ranks first on Artificial Analysis's Decision Index.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-liquid-d1-ultra/

Artificial Analysis ranks frontier models by how well they drive a robot arm

Its AA-Robotics v0.1 preview gives each model a six-axis arm and four cameras, and the top score is 69 for GPT-6 Astra, at about 30 minutes a task.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-aa-robotics-v01/

Perplexity open-sources SPACE, the Firecracker sandbox behind its Computer agent
https://theaipost.net/story/perplexity-space-open-source/

Anthropic gives six METR staff employee-like access and no veto

Anthropic says a six-person METR team now has the access of its internal risk reviewers, and that it cannot block METR's findings, only redact narrow categories.

https://theaipost.net/story/anthropic-metr-employee-access/

Accenture caps Claude funding at $29 a month per employee, 404 Media says

A memo seen by 404 Media says Accenture will fund only $29 of Claude use per person a month, though some staff had been spending up to $1,000.

https://theaipost.net/story/accenture-claude-29-dollar-cap/

Goodfire essay argues neural networks are already clean, not tangled
https://theaipost.net/story/goodfire-neural-networks-already-clean/

Nvidia opens a 120B vision model and a 24GB Bolt for desktops
https://theaipost.net/story/nvidia-nemotron-3-5-super-vl/

Black Forest Labs' FLUX.3 Klein draws to a box layout in 2 seconds

Hugging Face says FLUX.3 Image Klein makes a 1024-pixel image in about two seconds on an H100 and lets users draw boxes to set the layout.

https://theaipost.net/story/flux-3-image-klein-diffusers/

Krea opens its Krea 3 editing beta, promising 2K edits in 8 seconds

Krea says its new Krea 3 model makes end-to-end 2K image edits in under eight seconds and matches Nano Banana Pro quality, and the beta is open now.

https://theaipost.net/story/krea-3-image-editing-beta/

Mistral's Timestral forecasting models start at 5 million parameters

Mistral says its first time-series family tops three zero-shot forecasting leaderboards with a 209M model, while the 5M version forecasts a day ahead in 10 milliseconds on a server CPU.

https://theaipost.net/story/mistral-timestral-time-series/

Google's Universal Cart reaches Search and Gemini for US shoppers

Google says its Universal Cart now saves products from any retailer, watches for price drops and restocks, and checks out through its open Universal Commerce Protocol.

https://theaipost.net/story/google-universal-cart-us/

Simons Foundation, OpenAI and Anthropic fund a $15M AI-for-maths effort

The Simons Foundation says it will run a $15 million open call to help mathematicians check AI-produced results, with OpenAI putting in $5 million and both labs supplying compute.

https://theaipost.net/story/simons-ai-math-initiative/

GPT-6-Astra solves 49 of 50 physics research problems in a new test

A 35-author benchmark says OpenAI's GPT-6-Astra in Codex got 49 of 50 theoretical physics problems right at under $3 each, while Claude Opus 5.5 in Claude Code scored 92 percent.

https://theaipost.net/story/theophyseval-gpt-6-astra/

StepFun opens weights for 600B-parameter Step 5 Preview

StepFun says its agent-focused Step 5 Preview, a 600B mixture-of-experts model with a 1M-token window, is downloadable now, with vLLM and SGLang support from day one.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-step-5-preview-open-weights/

Swiss Apertus 1.5 takes images and audio, with a 262,144-token window
https://theaipost.net/story/find-apertus-1-5-release-notes/

Amazon's Bee adds a $75 wristband and a phone-back recorder

Amazon says its Bee Frontier listens all day for $74.99, with seven days of battery, and a $11.99-a-month Bee Pro plan hooks it into Alexa and Amazon shopping.

https://theaipost.net/story/amazon-bee-frontier-eclipse/

Anthropic tells investors distillation brings in 5 to 7 percent of revenue

The Decoder, citing The Information and the Financial Times, says Anthropic expects that income to fall, and that some investors now see an IPO valuation under $1.5 trillion.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-anthropic-distillation-revenue/

Fish Audio's Drama 3 voice model now runs in vLLM-Omni

The 35-billion-parameter speech model activates 3 billion per token and speaks 83 languages, its model card says, and vLLM reports 255 ms to first audio.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-fish-audio-drama-3/

Player-1 agents learn to play games from 16 synthetic worlds

Two Qwen3.5-based models rose from 10.5% to 38.3% on a Minecraft test after reinforcement learning, the paper's authors say, and also played Doom.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-player-1-game-agents/

TSMC guides fourth-quarter revenue up to $54.3 billion

The chipmaker's results page shows $46.72 billion in third-quarter revenue against a $44.6 billion to $45.8 billion forecast, with a $52.3 billion to $54.3 billion range for the next quarter.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-tsmc-q3-ai-guidance/

Figma lets teams write design rules in Markdown for AI agents

Figma Specs is a Markdown editor for design rules, and the company's code layers feature enters public beta, TechCrunch reported from Figma's first Config event in India.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-figma-config-india-agents/

Musk says SpaceX will repay Grok Bot users for errors

Elon Musk posted that SpaceX will "make you whole" if Grok Bot botches a purchase or leaks a card, adding it has never happened. No written policy backs the pledge.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-grok-bot-make-you-whole/

OpenAI agrees to stop using alleged Apple trade secrets in lawsuit

At a hearing, OpenAI agreed not to use material Apple says was stolen and to image the devices of 14 employees, and the judge called an injunction for Apple likely.

https://theaipost.net/story/c383ee815/

Vals AI says no model reached 2 out of 100 on its humanoid tasks

In real-time MuJoCo simulations, Vals says GPT-6.1 Sol averaged 51 on 13 robot-arm tasks, while the 11 humanoid tasks, which need balance and walking, stayed near zero.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-vals-robotics-sim/

Anthropic tells investors third-quarter revenue reached $16.8 billion

Bloomberg reports the figure, up from about $11.6 billion in the second quarter, went to prospective investors as the company pushes ahead with plans to go public.

https://theaipost.net/story/cb0c59de3/

Nvidia says tuning lifted a chip-design agent's score from 55% to 95%

In a case study with Siemens' Fuse EDA agent, Nvidia says better skills and tool descriptions cut agent turns by two thirds, using Claude Opus 4.8 in Claude Code.

https://theaipost.net/story/cac584057/

vLLM adaptive verification now works with draft models lacking a confidence head

A new estimator learns acceptance odds while serving, so EAGLE, MTP and DFlash checkpoints can use the feature with no retraining, the vLLM team says.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-vllm-adaptive-verification/
